semanticReview.method: Follow-up source-to-claim review separating morphology, lexical sense, construction meaning, passive/causative, result state, register and examples.
findings: La ficha combina varios tipos de 되다 (pasiva, resultativo y cambio de estado); falta evidencia que delimite cada patrón y sus ejemplos.
NIKL cautions against treating -게 되다/-아어지다 uniformly as passive; the article merges change, passive and result state.
limitations: No se creó Evidence canónica ni se modificó el artículo. La entrada permanece pendiente y no se declara VERIFIED.
Sources support only a subset; article-specific examples, translation choices and broad generalizations remain unchecked.
